title: A wobbly jelly
done: You made a wobbly jelly! Give the table a tiny shake. Does it wobble?

steps.say: Put a red square flat on the table. It is the plate.
Stand a green square up on the front side of the plate.
Stand another square up on the next side. They touch at the corner.
Stand a square up on the back side.
Stand the last square up. Wobble, wobble!
Lean four red triangles together on top until their points meet. A cherry!
